findings.resolution: PR 504 adds optional effectiveCpuCount as a finite positive value or null. Linux loadPerCore uses that value.
PR 504 maps the Linux CPU and memory values into the machine pressure response.
PR 504 adds typed memory fields and preserves each cgroup read state. Linux memoryLevel stays null.
PR 504 keeps cpuCount logical and adds effectiveCpuCount for Linux loadPerCore.
The exported dependency types are CgroupLimitReaderDeps and LinuxHostMetricsReaderDeps.
cgroup and hostMetrics use their own module folders and index files. The hostMetrics test moved with its module.
The Linux unsupported-platform case sits in processorTemperature.test.ts beside the reader tests.
The cgroup aggregation uses limitsByDirectory and strictestMemoryLimit.
Changed cgroup read failures log the path and error once per failure state. Partial read failures keep unknown values.
memoryUsedBytes comes only from memory.current. An unreadable usage stays unknown for an unlimited cgroup.
The scanner resolves each symbolic-link target and excludes escaped or unmapped targets.
The comment names scanPath and symlinks and explains the duplicate byte count.
The Git executor lives in apps/server/src/git/runGit and exports runGit for both services.
The API root exports the host transfer contract. The server imports it from @trellis/api.
The loop variable uses absolutePathEntry.
A missing database fails the inventory. Missing optional directories become explicit exclusions.
The endpoint schema accepts Darwin and Linux on x64 and arm64 and requires POSIX absolute paths.
The schema and fields use ProviderResumeCompatibility and providerResumeCompatibility.
Both Git object schemas require dirtyPaths.
The service and its folder use the plural name appendScannedObjects.
The inventory helpers use named folders. scanPath is nested under appendScannedObjects.
The schema comment defines a failed limit read and a known unlimited cgroup.
hostLoad names its second parameter effectiveCpuCount and uses it as the divisor.
services/agentRuns.ts exports readRuntimeSessions for the machine pressure service.
